body.statement: SPEC-8-5: When any one of several actors suffices (a substitution's one of owed_to ∪ release_by, an attested `impossible`'s one owed_to actor), `waiting_for` names each of them and `awaiting` lists each missing acceptance as the actors any one of whom gives it; an acceptance that another missing one implies is not listed, and `last_acceptance` is true only for an actor named in every missing one.
